g.text: Total $22,562.80 exceeds $10,000 -- requires VP extra scrutiny
Invoice INV-1013 from Atlas Industrial Supply for $22,562.80 is rejected under extra
scrutiny. The stated grand total of $22,562.80 does not match the recomputed total of
$22,512.80, a $50.00 overstatement. All three SKUs also fail stock checks: WidgetA
requests 22 units against 15 available, WidgetB requests 18 against 10, and GadgetX
requests 9 against 5. Multiple error-level findings on a high-dollar invoice mean the
evidence is not spotless and payment cannot be approved.
